c.v: The DMA Controller initialization should proceed as follows:
Write to the DMA Bus Mode Register (
) will set the Host bus's access parameters.
Write to the DMA Interrupt Enable Register (
) will mask any unnecessary interrupt causes.
The software driver creates either the inlink or the outlink descriptors.
Then, it writes to the DMA Descriptor List Base Address Register (
), providing the DMA Controller with the starting address of the list.
The DMA Controller engine attempts to acquire descriptors from descriptor lists.
